title: Bahria College KNCRE Agrataj Campus, Karachi | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Bahria College KNCRE Agrataj Campus, located in Karachi, Pakistan. Address: G-23 Taj Masjid Rd, Agra Taj Colony, Karachi.
